timing_note: mean of the per-macro-step wall time of the adapter's step alone, arms taking turns in a rotating order, inside the workbench server process

checks.title: Mass: released = held + carried out
checks.registered: 2026-09-29, before the transport family's first run
checks.measure: |change in the pollutant the river holds - dt (release + what crosses the edges)| over the mass released in the step, every step, worst arm
checks.why: the explicit finite-volume step moves mass face by face, what leaves one cell entering the next, so the full domain closes to the round-off of summing the field; the decomposed arm is the same step to round-off (the next check). 1e-9 leaves about four orders above that round-off

checks.title: Concentration agrees with the full domain
checks.registered: 2026-09-29, before the transport family's first run
checks.measure: max |c_decomposed - c_full| over the full domain's largest concentration, at the last step
checks.why: one explicit step on a window's cells is the full-domain step on those cells, so the arms differ only in the order of floating-point additions (the cut faces' rows, and the blend in the overlap): about one unit in the last place per step, which the monotone step never amplifies -- a few 1e-13 after a few thousand steps
checks.detail: max |dc| = 1.39e-16 mg/L against a peak of 1.585 mg/L

checks.title: Threaded equals serial, bit for bit
checks.registered: 2026-09-29, before the transport family's first run
checks.measure: np.array_equal on the concentration after every step
checks.why: each window's step reads only the previous step's field, and the blend adds the windows in their order, so the order the threads finish in cannot change a bit

notes: One explicit step of 2 s per macro-step, one exchange, no iteration: the stability limit here is 2.5 s (min h dx^2 / A_ii over the cells). Each window takes the full-domain step on its own cells, so the decomposed river is the full-domain river to round-off.

Reach shallow-fast: depth 1.25 m, so the water runs at 0.8 m/s; mixing 0.5 m^2/s; cell Peclet number u dx / D = 8, so what runs upstream across a face is 1/(1 + Pe) = 0.11 of what runs down. Upwinding adds 1.36 m^2/s of mixing along the flow.

Reach deep-slow: depth 2.5 m, so the water runs at 0.4 m/s; mixing 2 m^2/s; cell Peclet number u dx / D = 1, so what runs upstream across a face is 1/(1 + Pe) = 0.5 of what runs down. Upwinding adds 0.84 m^2/s of mixing along the flow.
The water takes 4250 s from the outfall to the outlet (macro-step 2125); this run covered 12000 s, so the plume has reached the outlet.
